stays: --font-from: 18   (redefined at a breakpoint: stays in the registry :root)
--font-to: 20   (redefined at a breakpoint: stays in the registry :root)
--vw-from: calc(1920 / 100)   (redefined at a breakpoint: stays in the registry :root)
--vw-to: calc(2400 / 100)   (redefined at a breakpoint: stays in the registry :root)
--t-ui: 1   (redefined at a breakpoint: stays in the registry :root)
--t-text: 1   (redefined at a breakpoint: stays in the registry :root)
--t-head: 1   (redefined at a breakpoint: stays in the registry :root)
--t-sub: 1   (redefined at a breakpoint: stays in the registry :root)
scroll-behavior: smooth   (redefined at a breakpoint: stays in the registry :root)
--t-disp: 1   (redefined at a breakpoint: stays in the registry :root)
--t-lg: 1   (redefined at a breakpoint: stays in the registry :root)
--t-mid: 1   (redefined at a breakpoint: stays in the registry :root)
--t-sm: 1   (redefined at a breakpoint: stays in the registry :root)
--ch-pad: 9rem   (redefined at a breakpoint: stays in the registry :root)
--bleed: 4.5rem   (redefined at a breakpoint: stays in the registry :root)
--coefficient: calc((var(--font-to) - var(--font-from)) / (var(--vw-to) - var(--vw-from)))
--base: calc((var(--font-from) - var(--vw-from) * var(--coefficient)) / 16)
--font-display: "Newsreader", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
--font-body: "Nunito Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
--font-ui: "Karla", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
--container-xlarge: 1600px   (a px layout limit: the Framework would emit it in rem, which the fluid root scales)
--container-large: 1360px   (a px layout limit: the Framework would emit it in rem, which the fluid root scales)
--container-medium: 1040px   (a px layout limit: the Framework would emit it in rem, which the fluid root scales)
--container-small: 760px   (a px layout limit: the Framework would emit it in rem, which the fluid root scales)
--gutter: clamp(1.25rem, 4.6vw, 5.5rem)
--radius: 2px   (the Framework writes 2-decimal rem; 0.13rem would shift it)
--radius-large: 3px   (the Framework writes 2-decimal rem; 0.19rem would shift it)
--hairline: 1px solid var(--beige)
--ease: cubic-bezier(.22, .61, .36, 1)
--f-lede: calc(1.125rem * var(--t-text))   (the Framework writes 2-decimal rem; 1.13rem would shift it)
--f-body: calc(.975rem * var(--t-text))   (the Framework writes 2-decimal rem; 0.97rem would shift it)
